summary: Well-structured test suite with strong coverage of core requirements: secret classification (expired/warning/ok), markdown and JSON output formats, configurable warning windows, and CI/CD integration. Three-tier organization (unit/structure/act) is excellent. Unit tests use deterministic fixtures with pinned dates (SRV_NOW=2026-06-28) and test boundary conditions (0 days, at window edge), error scenarios (invalid JSON, missing fields, bad dates, usage errors), and output exactness. Workflow structure tests verify YAML validity, triggers, jobs, dependency chain, and actionlint compliance. Act harness validates pipeline execution through actual Docker containers. Gaps: missing edge cases (stress tests with many secrets, multiple simultaneous invalid fields, permission/symlink scenarios), limited testing of --now argument vs SRV_NOW precedence, and required_by field handling could be more thorough (special characters, null values). Error handling tests cover main failure modes but not all permutations. Would reliably catch regressions in core classification logic and output formatting, but some corner cases might slip through.
